+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: run script over the combined view, with the grants of the layer that gives the script
+---
+## What
+
+`run script` must find a script in the combined view, and it must apply the grants of the layer that gives that script.
+
+1. `RunScript` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Resources/RunScript.swift`) resolves the path through the overlay, thus a script that only a lower layer holds can run, and a higher copy of the same path wins.
+2. `ScriptGate` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Resources/ScriptGate.swift`) applies the marketplace grants of the **layer that gives the resolved script**, not the grants of the layer of `SKILL.md`. This is the important safety rule: a local `SKILL.md` must not give a marketplace script more permission than its own marketplace gives it.
+3. The `scripts/` rule, the confinement rule and the correctives do not change.
+4. `ShellInjection` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Render/ShellInjection.swift`) runs its commands in the render of `SKILL.md`, thus it keeps the grants of the winning layer. State this in the comment, because it is now a difference from `run script`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A script that only a lower layer holds runs.
+- [ ] A script that two layers hold runs the copy of the higher layer.
+- [ ] A script that a marketplace layer gives runs under the grants of that marketplace, also when the winning `SKILL.md` is local.
+- [ ] A local `SKILL.md` cannot give more permission to a marketplace script.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` gives 0 warnings, and `swift test` is green.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/RunScriptTests.swift`: a script that only the defaults layer holds runs and gives its output.
+- [ ] Same file: the same script path in two layers runs the higher copy.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/ScriptGateTests.swift`: a marketplace layer with no run grant denies its script, although the local layer gives the winning `SKILL.md`.
+- [ ] `swift test` — all tests pass, 0 failures.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#dotfolder-overlay #skills
\ No newline at end of file
